meta.title: ARUVI — Indawo ethambile yezinsuku ezinzima
meta.description: Indawo yenhlalakahle yamahhala, eyimfihlo, enezilimi eziningi yabantu abaphila nesiqhwala (migraine), ukudangala, ukukhathazeka nengcindezi.

i18n.partial: I-{language} ihunyushwe ngomshini, ngakho amanye amagama angase angabi nembile ngokuphelele. Uma okuthile kungacaci, i-English, සිංහල ne-தமிழ் kuhlolwe ngokugcwele.

hero.title: Indawo ethambile yezinsuku ezinzima.
hero.body: Indawo ephephile nethulile yokubona ukuthi uzizwa kanjani, wehlise ijubane, futhi uzinakekele — ngaphandle kwengcindezi noma kokwahlulelwa.

mood.title: Uzizwa kanjani manje?
mood.subtitle: Ayikho impendulo efanele. Khetha okusondele kakhulu — kulungile uma kushintsha.
mood.privacy: Kulesi sibonelo, akukho okushiya idivayisi yakho.

responses.happy: Kuhle ukuthi namuhla kuzwakala kulula kancane. Ungabhala phansi okusizile, ukuze ubuyele kukho.
responses.calm: Isikhathi sokuthula kufanele siqashelwe. Hlala kuso isikhathi esingangoba ufuna.
responses.sad: Ukudabuka kungaba nzima. Akudingeki ukulungise manje — ukuzithambela kwanele.
responses.anxious: Ukukhathazeka kwenza konke kuzwakale kuphuthuma. Ukukhipha umoya kancane kungasiza umzimba wakho uzizwe uphephile kancane.
responses.overwhelmed: Uma konke kuba ngaphezulu, kulungile ukukhetha into eyodwa encane — noma ungenzi lutho nhlobo.
responses.irritated: Ukucasuka kuvame ukusho ukuthi okuthile kubalulekile kuwe. Ikhefu elifushane lingakunika isikhala esincane.
responses.exhausted: Lokhu kukhathala kungokoqobo. Ukuphumula akuyona into okumele uyisebenzele.
responses.lonely: Isizungu sinzima. Uma ukwazi, xhumana nomuntu omethembayo — ngisho nomlayezo omfushane ungasiza.
responses.numb: Ukungazizwa lutho kwesinye isikhathi kuyindlela ingqondo ezivikela ngayo. Usekhona, futhi lokho kubalulekile.

calm.title: Indawo Yami Yokuthula
calm.subtitle: Indawo ethulile yokwehlisa ukuphefumula kwakho. Misa isikhashana, shintsha noma uyeke noma nini.
calm.rounds: {count, plural, =0 {Awukho umjikelezo okwamanje} one {Umjikelezo # uqediwe} other {Imijikelezo # iqediwe}}
calm.note: Akukho kucwazimula noma ukunyakaza okusheshayo. Umsindo uhlala uvaliwe ngaphandle uma uwuvula.

features.title: Konke ngejubane lakho
features.subtitle: Sebenzisa okukusizayo, weqe okungakusizi. Akukho lapha okuwumsebenzi okumele uwuqede.

calm.title: Indawo Yokuthula
calm.body: Ukuphefumula, ukuzinzisa nokukhulula umzimba ngezithombe zemvelo ezithulile.

journal.title: Ijenali Yemizwa
journal.body: Qaphela imizwa yakho, bhala ngokukhululeka, futhi ubone amaphethini athambile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

companion.title: Umngane Wenhlalakahle we-AI
companion.body: Umlaleli osekelayo ngolimi lwakho. Akuyena udokotela noma umelaphi.

migraine.title: Ijenali Yesiqhwala
migraine.body: Bhala izigameko, izimpawu nezinto ezingase zikubangele, bese ukhipha umbiko kadokotela wakho.

sleep.title: Ukulala Namandla
sleep.body: Landelela ukuphumula, izinga lokulala namandla ukuze uqonde izinsuku zakho.

insights.title: Ukuqonda Inhlalakahle
insights.body: Izifinyezo ezilula, ezichazayo zalokho okubhalile — akusona isixilongo neze.

free.title: Mahhala kuwo wonke umuntu
free.body: Akukho ukubhalisa okukhokhelwayo, azikho izici ezikhokhelwayo.

private.title: Imfihlo kusukela ekuqaleni
private.body: Amajenali nezingxoxo zakho ngezakho. Asisoze sathengisa imininingwane yomuntu siqu noma yezempilo.

gentle.title: Akukho ngcindezi
gentle.body: Akukho ukubala izinsuku, akukho cala. Buya noma nini lapho udinga.

notMedical.title: Ukwesekwa, hhayi ukwelashwa
notMedical.body: I-ARUVI ayithathi indawo yokunakekelwa ngochwepheshe bezempilo noma bengqondo.

help.title: Uma udinga usizo manje
help.body: Uma usengozini noma ucabanga ukuzilimaza, sicela uxhumane nomuntu manje. Ufanelwe ukwesekwa.

lines.national: Ulayini Kazwelonke Wosizo Lwempilo Yengqondo (Sri Lanka, amahora angu-24)

help.note: I-ARUVI akuyona insiza yezimo eziphuthumayo. Uma ungase wenze imicabango yokuzilimaza, sicela uxhumane nenye yalezi zinsiza noma uye esibhedlela esiseduze.
help.noList: Asikabi nalo uhlu oluqinisekisiwe lwemigqa yosizo yaleli zwe. Sicela ushayele inombolo yezimo eziphuthumayo yendawo noma uye esibhedlela esiseduze. Ungathola nolayini wosizo wamahhala noyimfihlo oseduze nawe lapha:

footer.disclaimer: I-ARUVI ingumngane wenhlalakahle osekelayo. Ayithathi indawo yokwelashwa ngochwepheshe bezempilo noma bengqondo.
footer.made: Kwenziwe ngokunakekela. Mahhala kuwo wonke umuntu.

common.error: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Sicela uzame futhi.

auth.signInSubtitle: Ngena ukuze ubone ijenali, amanothi nokuqonda kwakho.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Mahhala, imfihlo futhi ngeyakho. Ungasusa konke noma nini.
auth.name: Sikubize ngokuthini?
auth.passwordHint: Okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-10. Umusho omfushane usebenza kahle.
auth.acceptHealth: Ngiyavuma ukuthi i-ARUVI igcine imininingwane yenhlalakahle engikhetha ukuyifaka (imizwa, amajenali, amanothi esiqhwala nokulala), ngasese futhi kuphela kimina.
auth.tryWithout: Noma zama umsebenzi wokuphefumula ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti
auth.birthYearHint: I-ARUVI ingeyabantu abaneminyaka eyi-16 nangaphezulu. Nguwe kuphela ongabona lokhu.
auth.tooYoung: I-ARUVI ingeyabantu abaneminyaka eyi-16 nangaphezulu, ngakho asikwazi ukukudalela i-akhawunti okwamanje. Uma izinto zinzima, sicela ukhulume nomuntu omdala omethembayo noma ushayele ulayini wosizo.
auth.concernsHint: Khetha noma yikuphi okufanelekile. Lokhu kushintsha kuphela lokho i-ARUVI ekukhombisa kona — akusona isixilongo.
auth.welcomeSubtitle: Lokhu kusiza i-ARUVI ikulingane. Nguwe kuphela ongakubona.

overview.subtitle: Unjani namuhla? Akukho okumele ukwenze lapha.
overview.verifyFailed: Lelo xhumanisi lokuqinisekisa alisebenzanga noma liphelelwe yisikhathi.
overview.verifyPending: Sikuthumelele isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa i-imeyili yakho. Okwamanje, ungaqhubeka usebenzisa i-ARUVI.
overview.calmBody: Ukuphefumula okumbalwa kancane, noma nini lapho udinga.

suggestions.1: Phuma ngaphandle noma uvule iwindi ukuze uthole umoya opholile umzuzu owodwa.
suggestions.2: Khulula amahlombe akho futhi uyeke umhlathi wakho uthambe.
suggestions.4: Phumulisa amehlo akho kude nezikrini imizuzu emihlanu.
suggestions.5: Qaphela into eyodwa encane ehambe kahle namuhla.

overview.noJournal: Akukabhalwa lutho. Ngisho nomugqa owodwa ungasiza.

journal.title: Imizwa nejenali
journal.subtitle: Qaphela ukuthi uzizwa kanjani futhi ubhale ngokukhululeka. Nguwe kuphela ongakubona lokhu.
journal.privateNote: Imfihlo kusukela ekuqaleni. Akwabelwa muntu neze.

prompts.0: Iyiphi into eyodwa ebe nzima namuhla, futhi iyiphi ebe lula kancane?
prompts.2: Chaza indawo lapho uzizwa uphephile khona.
prompts.5: Yini eqede amandla akho namuhla? Yini ebuyise amanye?
prompts.6: Ukube imizwa yakho ibiyisimo sezulu, ibiyoba yisiphi?
prompts.7: Iyiphi into enomusa ongazenzela yona kusasa?

migraine.title: Ijenali yesiqhwala
migraine.subtitle: Gcina ijenali elula yekhanda ongayabelana nodokotela wakho.
migraine.disclaimer: Le jenali ibhala lokho okuqaphelayo. Amaphethini aboniswa lapha awasona isixilongo sezempilo. Sicela ukhulume nodokotela ngekhanda lakho nanoma imuphi umuthi.
migraine.intensityHint: 0 kusho ukungabikho kobuhlungu, 10 kusho ubuhlungu obubi kakhulu ongabucabanga.
migraine.triggersHint: Kuphela lokho okuqaphele wena. Lokhu kungamathuba, hhayi izimbangela.
migraine.medicationHint: Inothi lakho kuphela. I-ARUVI ayiphakamisi muthi neze.

report.title: Umbiko wejenali yekhanda
report.disclaimer: Lo mbiko uqukethe imininingwane ebhalwe ngumuntu ngokwakhe ku-ARUVI. Akusona isixilongo. Izinto ezingase zibangele ziwukuqaphela komuntu siqu.

sleep.title: Ukulala namandla
sleep.subtitle: Inothi elifushane lansuku zonke mayelana nokuphumula namandla likusiza uqonde izinsuku zakho.
sleep.dateHint: Bhala ukulala kwayizolo ebusuku osukwini lwanamuhla.

insights.title: Ukuqonda inhlalakahle
insights.subtitle: Ukubheka okulula kulokho okubhalile.
insights.disclaimer: Lezi yizincazelo zamanothi akho, hhayi iziphetho zezempilo. Uma izinto ezimbili zivela ndawonye, akusho ukuthi enye ibangela enye.
insights.notEnough: Qhubeka ubhala isikhashana, ukuqaphela okuthambile kuzovela lapha.

obs.topTrigger: Ubhale "{trigger}" njengento engase ibangele ezigamekweni ezingu-{count} kwezingu-{total}.
obs.lowSleepMigraine: Ku-{share}% wezinsuku obhale ngazo isiqhwala, ubuphinde wabhala ukulala okungaphansi kwamahora angu-6, uma kuqhathaniswa no-{overall}% wabo bonke ubusuku obubhalile.

keepAiHistory.title: Gcina umlando wezingxoxo nomngane
keepAiHistory.body: Kuvaliwe kusukela ekuqaleni. Uma ukuvula, izingxoxo zakho ziyalondolozwa ukuze ubuyele kuzo. Ungazisusa noma nini.

settings.comfortNote: Indikimba, usayizi wombhalo nolimi kusebhayini ephezulu, futhi kukhunjulwa kule divayisi.
settings.exportBody: Thola ikhophi yakho konke i-ARUVI ekugcinayo ngawe, njengefayela le-JSON.
settings.deleteBody: Lokhu kusula unomphela i-akhawunti yakho nakho konke okukuyo: imizwa, amajenali, amanothi nezingxoxo. Akukwazi ukubuyiswa.

companion.title: Umngane
companion.subtitle: Yabelana ngokusengqondweni yakho. Bhala nganoma yiluphi ulimi olufunayo.
companion.disclaimer: Umngane uyi-AI, hhayi umelaphi noma udokotela. Angenza amaphutha futhi akakwazi ukuxilonga noma ukunikeza iseluleko sezempilo. Uma usengozini, sicela usebenzise izinombolo ezisengxenyeni ethi “Thola usizo” noma ushayele inombolo yezimo eziphuthumayo yendawo.
companion.historyOff: Izingxoxo azilondolozwa. Ziyanyamalala uma ushiya leli khasi.
companion.crisisBody: Kubonakala sengathi izinto zinzima ngempela manje. Sicela uxhumane nomuntu ongasiza — ungashayela manje, noma nini.
